page.meta_description: Turkish coffee, cooked in a cezve, is the older pot method that reached Europe from Ottoman cafés before espresso existed. Related pages: Yemen.
page.content:
Unfiltered pot brew of finely ground coffee, a Near Eastern classic.

How Turkish coffee connects

  • Location: Yemen — Turkish pot coffee sits on the older Ottoman and Red Sea drinking line from Yemeni trade.

What is Turkish coffee?

Turkish coffee, cooked in a cezve, is the older pot method that reached Europe from Ottoman cafés before espresso existed.

Key threads lead to Yemen.
